highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: New research reveals limitations of vendor advisories in identifying critical security vulnerabilities and BTCPay Server urges users to update after hot wallet attacks. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Cops bust botnet of 1.3M infected Android TV boxes. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware targeting outdated NAS devices. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
